text: 深成指、科创50均跌超4%，沪指跌2.35%，创业板指跌3.89%，沪深京三市下跌个股近4800只，其中近630股跌超9%。
text_en: The Shenzhen Component Index and the STAR 50 both fell over 4%, the Shanghai Composite Index fell 2.35%, and the ChiNext Index fell 3.89%. Nearly 4,800 stocks declined across the Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Beijing markets, with nearly 630 stocks falling over 9%.
